---
title: "Hazelnut price forecasting"
title-tr: "Fındık fiyatı tahmini"
description: "Every forecasting method we tried against naive (the price stays where it is): the development scoreboard, calm and shock months, the holdout, ranges, crop estimates and the lira."
description-tr: "Denediğimiz her tahmin yönteminin naif tahmine (fiyat olduğu yerde kalır) karşı sonuçları: geliştirme dönemi puan tablosu, sakin ve şok ayları, ayrılmış test dönemi, aralıklar, rekolte tahminleri ve TL cinsinden tahminler."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.forecast.dataset import LIRA_CRISES, SHOCK_PERIODS
from hazelnut.site import charts, i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t
from hazelnut.site.labels import method_name

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
res = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "results"
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "manifest.json")
stamp = ph.as_of_stamp(manifest) if manifest is not None else None
K = f"{crop.slug}.analyses.forecasting"  # this page's strings in site/i18n

dev = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_dev.csv",
                          required=("method", "horizon", "n", "mae", "ratio"))
holdout = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_holdout.csv",
                              required=("method", "horizon", "n", "ratio"))
shocks = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_shocks.csv",
                             required=("method", "horizon", "period", "mae", "ratio"))
f3 = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "forecast_3m.csv",
                         required=("target_month", "actual", "naive", "best_other",
                                   "best_other_method"))
ranges = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "ranges.csv",
                             required=("method", "horizon", "cov80", "width80", "cov90", "skill"))
band = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "range_band_3m.csv",
                           required=("target_month", "actual", "q10", "q90"))
check = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "crop_check.csv",
                            required=("method", "horizon", "crop_source", "ratio"))
lira = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "lira.csv",
                           required=("method", "horizon", "period", "mape_ratio", "mae_ratio",
                                     "dm_p"))

# Hazelnut-specific choices -------------------------------------------------------------
NOT_IN_MULTIPLE = ("season_reg",)  # its errors are already large in calm months
CROP_SOURCE = "giresun"            # the crop estimate the standard inputs use
RANGE_BASE = "naive_emp"           # the range the dashboard shows
BAND_HORIZON = 3                   # range_band_3m.csv / forecast_3m.csv
LIRA_TREND = "composed_fx_drift_36"
LIRA_TRENDS = {m: t(f"{K}.lira_trend.{m}") for m in ("composed_fx_drift_36", "composed_fx_infl")}
# The rows of the lira report's table, in its order (the sixth FX variant, spot + 12-month
# drift, is not in the report's table; it stays in results/lira.csv).
LIRA_NAMES = {m: t(f"{K}.lira_method.{m}") for m in (
    "naive", "try_drift_36", "try_drift_12", "composed_fx_drift_36", "composed_fx_drift_12",
    "composed_fx_infl", "composed_fx_spot", "composed_fx_spot_drift_36", "try_sarima",
    "try_lightgbm")}

order = [m for m, _, _ in ph.scoreboard_rows(dev)] if dev is not None else None
RATIO3 = ph.fmt_ratio(3)
RATIO_HEAD = t(f"{K}.ratio_head")


def foot(text):
    """A panel's footnote, from plain text."""
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(text, quote=False)}</p>')
```

```{python}
parts = []
if dev is not None:
    others = dev[dev["method"] != ph.NAIVE]
    if (others["ratio"] >= 1).all():
        parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_none_beat"))
    else:
        parts.append(ph.dev_subtitle(dev))
if holdout is not None:
    winners = [n for m, n, r in ph.scoreboard_rows(holdout)
               if m != ph.NAIVE and all(v < 1 for v in r.values())]
    if not winners:
        parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_holdout_none"))
if shocks is not None:
    lo, hi = ph.shock_multiple(shocks, NOT_IN_MULTIPLE)
    parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_shocks", low=i18n.fmt_number(lo, 1), high=i18n.fmt_number(hi, 1)))
if band is not None:
    share, _, _ = ph.band_held(band)
    parts.append(t(f"{K}.found_band", pct=ph.fmt_pct(share), horizon=BAND_HORIZON))
found = " ".join(parts) or t(f"{K}.found_fallback")
ph.raw_html(ph.analysis_head_html(i18n.crop_name(crop), t(f"{K}.title"), t(f"{K}.h1"),
                                  found, stamp))
```

::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
```{=html}
<div class="sect analysis-sect"><div><span class="eyebrow">Point forecasts, USD</span><h2>The scoreboard</h2></div></div>
```
:::

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-dev .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.dev_title")
if dev is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.dev_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.dev_subtitle(dev)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(dev, [(RATIO_HEAD, "ratio", RATIO3)],
                                     caption=t(f"{K}.dev_caption"), order=order,
                                     methods_href="../../methods.qmd"))
    naive = dev[dev["method"] == ph.NAIVE].sort_values("horizon")
    foot(t(f"{K}.dev_foot", count=ph.count_text(dev["n"]),
           errors=" / ".join(ph.fmt_usd(v) for v in naive["mae"]),
           horizons=" / ".join(str(int(h)) for h in naive["horizon"])))
```
:::

::: {#panel-shocks .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.shocks_title")
if shocks is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.shocks_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.shock_subtitle(shocks, NOT_IN_MULTIPLE)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        ph.shock_table(shocks),
        [(t(f"{K}.calm_head"), "calm", RATIO3), (t(f"{K}.shock_head"), "shock", RATIO3)],
        caption=t(f"{K}.shocks_caption"),
        order=order))
    foot(t(f"{K}.shocks_foot", years=ph.shock_years_label(SHOCK_PERIODS)))
```
:::

::: {#panel-forecast-3m .panel .span-12}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.f3_title", horizon=BAND_HORIZON)
if f3 is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.f3_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    other = method_name(str(f3["best_other_method"].iloc[0]))
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.forecast_3m_subtitle(f3, BAND_HORIZON)))
    # Only the shock periods that start inside the chart's months are shaded.
    shaded = [s for s in SHOCK_PERIODS if s[0] <= str(f3["target_month"].max())]
    charts.show(charts.forecast_vs_actual(f3, other, shaded))
    foot(t(f"{K}.f3_foot", first=ph.month_label(f3["target_month"].min()),
           last=ph.month_label(f3["target_month"].max()), other=other, horizon=BAND_HORIZON))
```
:::

::: {#panel-holdout .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.holdout_title")
if holdout is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.holdout_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.holdout_subtitle(holdout)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(holdout, [(RATIO_HEAD, "ratio", RATIO3)],
                                     caption=t(f"{K}.holdout_caption"), order=order))
    notes = []
    if dev is not None:
        notes.append(ph.holdout_dev_note(holdout, dev) or "")
    notes.append(t(f"{K}.holdout_spike"))
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(" ".join(n for n in notes if n))}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-crop-check .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.check_title")
if check is None or dev is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.check_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.crop_check_subtitle(
        dev, check, CROP_SOURCE, rule=t(f"{K}.check_rule"))))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        ph.crop_check_table(dev, check, CROP_SOURCE), [(RATIO_HEAD, "ratio", RATIO3)],
        caption=t(f"{K}.check_caption"),
        row="row", names=lambda r: r, highlight=None, row_head=t(f"{K}.check_row_head")))
    foot(t(f"{K}.check_foot"))
```
:::

::: {#panel-lira-split .panel .span-5}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.lira_split_title")
if lira is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.lira_split_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.lira_split_subtitle(lira, LIRA_TREND)))
    wide = ph.lira_split(lira, LIRA_TREND, ("calm", "crisis"))
    wide.columns = [t("hazelnut.chart.calm_months"), t("hazelnut.chart.lira_crises")]
    charts.show(charts.ratio_bars(wide, highlight=wide.columns[1]))
    mape = '<a href="../../methods.qmd#mape">MAPE</a>'
    text = t(f"{K}.lira_split_foot", mape=mape,
             periods=ph.escape(ph.periods_label(LIRA_CRISES), quote=False))
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{text}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-lira .panel .span-7}
```{python}
TITLE = t(f"{K}.lira_title")
if lira is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, t(f"{K}.lira_fallback")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    # USD naive x FX variants tried; the gains are suggestive at most.
    n_fx = lira.loc[lira["method"].astype(str).str.startswith("composed_fx"), "method"].nunique()
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.lira_subtitle(
        lira, list(LIRA_TRENDS), t(f"{K}.lira_trend_words"),
        caveat=t(f"{K}.lira_caveat", n=n_fx) if n_fx else None)))
    allm = lira[(lira["period"] == "all") & lira["method"].isin(list(LIRA_NAMES))]
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        allm, [(t(f"{K}.mape_head"), "mape_ratio", ph.fmt_ratio(2)),
               (t(f"{K}.mae_head"), "mae_ratio", ph.fmt_ratio(2))],
        caption=t(f"{K}.lira_caption"),
        names=LIRA_NAMES.get, order=list(LIRA_NAMES)))
    dm = (f'<a href="../../methods.qmd#p-value">'
          f'{ph.escape(t(f"{K}.dm_link"), quote=False)}</a>')
    csv = f'<a href="../../data/{crop.slug}/results/lira.csv">lira.csv</a>'
    text = t(f"{K}.lira_foot", dm=dm, csv=csv,
             p_note=ph.escape(ph.lira_p_note(lira, LIRA_TRENDS)))
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{text}</p>')
```
